blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The co-accused of former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co is due for discharge upon doctor’s clearance after suffering a stroke, the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division learned on Tuesday. Juliet Calvo, the former Maintenance Division chief of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in Region IV-B, faces a malversation case filed against her and eight of her other co-accused under the jurisdiction of the anti-graft court. After the testimony of Calvo’s co-accused Felisardo Casuno, Calvo’s lawyer Edwin Labro informed the court that there was a scheduled Wednesday hearing to tackle her condition. “The purpose of the hearing has become moot […]...
